title: Rigid Paper Packaging Structure RFQ Brief SourceBridge
buyerQuestion: How should buyers compare rigid paper packaging structures before RFQ?
legalName: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.

gscBasis.source: /Users/molice/Obsidian仓库/03_项目归档/摩戈包装GEO推广/Google数据闭环/GSC排名基线/2026-06-22_0023_GSC查询词排名基线.md

buyerInputs: Product dimensions, packed weight and number of items per set
Retail channel and use case, such as premium retail, gift set, beauty set, ecommerce launch or distributor presentation
Preferred structure, including rigid lid-and-base box, drawer box, magnetic closure box, sleeve box or mixed paper packaging set
Paperboard thickness direction and visible surface requirements for internal review
Insert, tray, divider or product movement-control requirement
Surface finish direction, such as matte lamination, foil stamping, embossing, spot UV, textured paper or special paper review
Artwork status, logo placement and mandatory label area
Target market and any document questions that require project-specific review

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Only says rigid paper packaging needed
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: States lid-and-base, drawer, magnetic, sleeve or set-box direction with product dimensions

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: No packed weight or movement-control detail
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Lists product weight, set count, insert need and display or shipping context
Provides finish references such as matte, foil, embossing, spot UV or textured paper

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: No target retail or shipping context
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Separates boutique retail, ecommerce, gift set, distributor presentation and market document questions

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Assumes supplier can guarantee all certification or labeling needs
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Keeps certification, labeling and regulated-market review tied to project documents
